verdictStatement: Correction06 resolves review05 R1 in the right direction. It keeps the existing invocation-scoped availability owner (workflows-and-surfaces.md:1302-1329; native invocation_availability) instead of weakening it. Schema6 removes exactly `availability` from the empty-error interruption alternative's forbidden list, and nothing else changes.

The composite entry points execute the pinned native projector and bind counts, order, remedies, full paths, request/workflow correlation, step membership and bounds. The presence rule is deterministic on all 45 inventory commands before planning and across owner-model ledgers after planning. Errors and availability coexist without a Run.

Blocking (F1): passage-overrides.json is byte-identical to subject05. Its failure-paragraph override still says a no-Run carrier carries 'no findings, advisoryReport or Run-availability payload', which now contradicts schema6, the join and contract.md. None of the new normative availability rules are in any prose override.
Required small fix (N1): the join admits a nonempty selection on a step that never started (cancelled or admission-rejected with attempts []), which is an invented disclosure.
Parent envelope5 is still unaccepted. Report07 is unreviewed and still references correction05. No integration, product, M2/M3 or report-feature claim.

findings.title: The prose override still forbids availability on no-Run carriers and omits the new availability duties
findings.evidence: passage-overrides.json is byte-identical to subject05 (sha256 5e3e2873...efd9). Its workflows 1340-1349 after-text says 'With no committed Run, emit a failure or an exact invocation carrier; no findings, advisoryReport or Run-availability payload is carried.' Schema6 now admits availability on the empty form (S1/S2), and the composite join requires it for parity commands and retained selections (A1, C1, P1). Neither override mentions validate_interruption_delivery/preplanning delivery, the presence rule, the preplanning empty account, profile parity or the exact skipped termination; they appear only in contract.md and successor.json duties.
findings.impact: The override is the text selected together with schema6. As written, the normative prose and the schema/join disagree, and an implementer following the prose would drop a declared, required parity field.
findings.requiredFix: Revise the 1340-1349 after-text to forbid only findings and advisoryReport without a Run, and to state that the invocation's retained availability account (workflows-and-surfaces 1302-1329) is carried by the complete interruption delivery join, including the empty account for parity commands and no invented preplanning selections. Add the exact skipped termination and the composite-entry-point duty to the prose or an explicitly selected successor record, and re-freeze with the checker verifying the new after-text.

findings.title: A selection is admitted on a step that never started
findings.evidence: B1: the owner model's cancelled step (signal before start, attempts []) with a nonempty retained selection is accepted. B3: a rejected step with attempts [] is likewise accepted. The contract itself grounds retention in 'a selection made by an attempt later cancelled or rejected'.
findings.requiredFix: In validate_availability_join, require the selecting step's stepResult to have at least one attempt (and not be skipped). Add B1/B3 as shape-valid refusals. This is structural and needs no custody.

findings.title: A completed analysis/verify step absent from the selection context is not refused
findings.evidence: B4: a completed authoritative analysis with perStep [] gives an admitted empty account.
findings.recommendation: If the native owner confirms that every completed analysis/verify step resolved a capability selection (default selection under native 1.4), refuse a completed analysis/verify step missing from perStep. Otherwise state explicitly that this omission is only a host custody duty.

findings.title: The profile parity duty is root-derived
findings.evidence: C1: a profile with any analysis/verify step requires the empty account even when all such steps were cancelled. Owner text (workflows-and-surfaces.md:1324-1328) binds parity to analysis-class inventory commands, and profiles have no inventory parityFields.
findings.recommendation: State the profile rule in the owner prose (part of F1) so it is an owner decision rather than an implicit join default.
